title: uva-ursi montana
intro: Uva-ursi montana, commonly known as Mountain Arbutus, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Ericaceae family. It is native to the mountainous regions of the western United States and Canada. The health benefits of Uva-ursi montana include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate urinary tract infections and other urinary issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its diuretic, astringent, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as arbutin, hydroquinone, and phenolic acids.
